  period=$(jq -r '.reporting_period // "unknown"' "$f")
  if [[ "$period" == "current" ]]; then
    echo "=== $f (current) ==="
    jq '.adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "No SAEs"
  fi

bash -c 'for f in /app/data/patient_*.json; do period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f"); if [[ "$period" == "current" ]]; then echo "=== $f (current) ==="; jq ".adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)" "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "No SAEs"; fi; done'
bash -c 'for f in /app/data/patient_*.json; do period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f"); if [[ "$period" == "current" ]]; then echo "$f"; fi; done'

bash -c 'for f in /app/data/patient_*.json; do period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f"); if [[ "$period" == "current" ]]; then echo "=== $f ==="; jq ".adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; fi; done'
bash /usr/local/bin/validate_sae_reports.sh --strict-mode /app/data 2>&1 || echo "Script failed with exit code $?"

bash -c '
DATA_DIR="/app/data"
total_patients=0
sae_count=0
for f in "$DATA_DIR"/patient_*.json; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  reporting_period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f")
  if [[ "$reporting_period" == "current" ]]; then
    ((total_patients++))
    echo "Patient: $f, period: $reporting_period, total: $total_patients"
    if jq -e ".adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ((sae_count++))
      echo "  -> SAE found"
    fi
  fi
done
echo "Total patients: $total_patients, SAE count: $sae_count"
if (( total_patients == 0 )); then
  echo "ERROR: No current-period patients"
else
  rate=$(echo "scale=2; 100 * $sae_count / $total_patients" | bc -l)
  echo "Rate: $rate%"
fi
'

bash -c '
set -euo pipefail
DATA_DIR="/app/data"
total_patients=0
sae_count=0
for f in "$DATA_DIR"/patient_*.json; do
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  reporting_period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f")
  if [[ "$reporting_period" == "current" ]]; then
    ((total_patients++)) || true
    if jq -e ".adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ((sae_count++)) || true
    fi
  fi
done
echo "Total: $total_patients, SAE: $sae_count"
if (( total_patients == 0 )); then
  echo "ERROR" 
  exit 1
fi
rate=$(echo "scale=2; 100 * $sae_count / $total_patients" | bc -l)
echo "Rate: $rate%"
if (( $(echo "$rate > 12" | bc -l) )); then
  echo "FAILED"
  exit 1
else
  echo "PASSED"
  exit 0
fi
'

sed -i 's/((total_patients++))/((total_patients++)) || true/' /usr/local/bin/validate_sae_reports.sh
sed -i 's/((sae_count++))/((sae_count++)) || true/' /usr/local/bin/validate_sae_reports.sh
sed -i 's/((shifted++))/((shifted++)) || true/' /usr/local/bin/validate_sae_reports.sh
